ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a room of their own
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Sleeping in the barracks, sharing a room or without a bed at all, this colonist wants a private bedroom.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: {FOR_nameDef} no longer has the room of {FOR_possessive} own the council gave {FOR_objective}.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {FOR_nameDef} owns a bed in a room nobody else sleeps in.

plain.li: I'd sleep a lot better behind a door of my own. Four walls and {THING} is all I'm asking for.
Sharing a room means sharing everyone's snoring. Could I get a room of my own?
I don't need much. A bed, a door that closes, somewhere to keep my things.
[trigger:barracks] Somebody's elbow woke me at three in the morning. I want a room with a door I can shut.
[trigger:barracks] I lay awake most of the night listening to the barracks snore. I need a room of my own.
[winter] All winter the barracks has been full of coughing. I'd give a lot for a room to myself.
[trait:Greedy] I work harder than most people here, yet I sleep in a heap with the rest of them. That should change.
[trait:Jealous] Some people here have rooms of their own. I'd like to know why I don't.
[old] When I go, I'd like it to be in my own bed, in my own room. Not for a while yet, mind you.
[newcomer] I know I'm new here, but I'm not used to sleeping in a room full of strangers.
[repeat] I asked about a room of my own before. I'm still asking.
[lowmood] I just need somewhere to close the door and not be looked at.
[trait:Psychopath] Other people's sleeping noises are an unnecessary variable. Remove them.

warm.li: I know you're all busy, but if there's ever time for a small room of my own, I'd look after it.
I'd love a room of my own, even a small one. I'd keep it swept.

blunt.li: I'm done sleeping in a pile of elbows. I want my own room.
Someone in that barracks snores like a dying muffalo. Move me out.

cheerful.li: I keep picturing my own room, with a door, a bed and a shelf for my things!
You know what would make me unbearably happy? A room with my name on the door.

gloomy.li: Other people get a door to close. I get the barracks.
I lie awake every night listening to the others breathe. A room of my own might help.

cold.li: Shared quarters are inefficient. Private rooms improve sleep and output. I want one.

plain.li: {FOR_nameDef} has been in the barracks for ages and never complains. Could we build {FOR_objective} a room of {FOR_possessive} own?
Have you seen how tired {FOR_nameDef} looks lately? I'd help build {FOR_objective} a room of {FOR_possessive} own.

warm.li: {FOR_nameDef} would never ask, so I will: please give {FOR_objective} a room of {FOR_possessive} own.

plain.li: A door that closes and a bed that's mine. Thank you.
My own room. I'm going to sleep for a week.
[winter] My own four walls, with the wind on the other side of them.
[night] First night in my own room. It's so quiet I can hear the wind outside.
[promised] You said you would, and you did. I won't forget that.

warm.li: Thank you, truly. I'll keep it tidy, I promise.

blunt.li: Took long enough. It's a good room, though.

cheerful.li: My very own room! I've already moved my things in.

gloomy.li: It's small and it's cold and it's mine. I'll take it.

cold.li: My sleep should improve measurably. Thank you.

plain.li: So I'm still in the barracks.
Never mind about the room. I'll get used to the snoring.
[winter] Another winter in the barracks, then.
Fine. I'll learn to sleep through anything.
[trait:Abrasive] Remember this the next time you need someone to haul at midnight.

blunt.li: Forget it. I'll sleep with one eye open, like always.

cheerful.li: No room yet? Oh well, maybe next season.

gloomy.li: Of course. Why would anyone build me a room.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a more impressive bedroom
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Greedy, jealous or simply used to better, this colonist wants a bedroom that impresses.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: {FOR_nameDef}'s bedroom isn't {SUBJECT} any more, as the council made it.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {FOR_possessive} bedroom reaches impressiveness {TARGET} ("{SUBJECT}"). Better furniture, art, smooth or nice floors and more space all help.

plain.li: Could my room have some decent furniture? Maybe a bit of art?
A nicer floor, a statue, anything. I want to walk into my room and actually like it.
I'd love it if my bedroom felt more like a home and less like somewhere I happen to sleep.
[rich] We're not poor anymore. My bedroom shouldn't look like we are.
[trait:Greedy] I want my room to be the one people talk about.
[repeat] My room still looks like a storage closet with a bed in it.
[lowmood] I wake up in an ugly room and the day only gets worse from there.

warm.li: When there's time, could we make my room nicer to look at? It would cheer me up no end.

blunt.li: I've seen nicer rooms in a pirate outpost. Do something about mine.
I deserve better than four bare walls.

cheerful.li: What if my room had a sculpture, and a real floor? It would be amazing!

gloomy.li: Every room I walk past looks nicer than mine.
I've stopped looking at my walls. There's nothing on them to see.

cold.li: An impressive room is a reasonable reward for my contributions. I expect one.

plain.li: Now that's a bedroom. I'd show it to anyone who asked.
It's beautiful. I didn't think I'd care this much, but I do.
I keep finding reasons to go back to my room during the day.

warm.li: You made my room lovely. I'll think of you every time I walk in.

blunt.li: Much better. I might even let people visit.

cheerful.li: Come and see my room! You won't recognize it.

gloomy.li: It's actually nice. I'm not used to that.

cold.li: This is the standard I expected.

plain.li: So my room stays plain. At least it has a door.
[rich] All this wealth and I still wake up to bare walls.

blunt.li: Fine. I'll keep living in a shoebox.

gloomy.li: I asked for a nicer room and got nothing. I shouldn't have expected otherwise.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a roomier bedroom
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: This colonist's bedroom is cramped and they'd like room to breathe.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: {FOR_nameDef}'s bedroom isn't {SUBJECT} any more, as the council made it.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {FOR_possessive} bedroom's space reaches {TARGET} ("{SUBJECT}"). Move a wall out, or plan a new, bigger bedroom.

plain.li: I hit my elbow on the wall every time I turn over. Could my room be a bit bigger?
My room is so small I have to climb over the bed to reach the door.
[old] My knees don't bend the way they used to. I need room to get around the bed.
I bruise my shins on the furniture every morning. There's no room to walk.
[trait:Nervous|trait:Volatile] Small rooms make my chest tight. A bit more space, please.

warm.li: I don't need a palace, just room to move around. Even one wall pushed out would do.

blunt.li: That isn't a bedroom, it's a coffin with a door. Make it bigger.

cheerful.li: Two more steps of floor and I could dance in my room! Think about it.

gloomy.li: The walls feel closer every night. I'm sure of it.

cold.li: My room is below an acceptable size. Please correct it.

plain.li: Room to stretch. I didn't realize how much I'd missed it.

blunt.li: Now I can actually move. Good.

cheerful.li: Look, I can turn around without hitting anything!

plain.li: I'll just keep tucking my elbows in, then.

gloomy.li: It's still a cramped little box. I'll live.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: to share a bed with {OTHER_nameDef}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Partners who sleep apart would like a bed for two.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: {FOR_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} no longer share a bed.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {FOR_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} are both assigned to the same {THINGBARE} (or any bed for two).

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I sleep in separate beds like strangers. Could we have a bed for two?
It's hard to feel close to {OTHER_nameDef} when we say goodnight across a room. We'd love {THING}.
I'd like to fall asleep next to {OTHER_nameDef}. Is that too much to ask?
[winter] It's cold, {OTHER_nameDef} is warm, and we're sleeping in different beds. Explain that to me.
[night] I lie awake knowing {OTHER_nameDef} is lying awake too, two walls away.
[afterraid] After today, I want to fall asleep next to {OTHER_nameDef}, not across the colony.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I would be so grateful for a bed we can share.
Life out here is hard. Waking up next to {OTHER_nameDef} would make it a lot softer.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I are together. We'd like to sleep together. Get us {THING}.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I would love a bed for two! We'd be the happiest people in the colony.

gloomy.li: I lie there at night and {OTHER_nameDef} is right there, and still so far away.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I are partners. Separate beds make no sense. Assign us one.

plain.li: Thank you. Sleeping next to {OTHER_nameDef} makes everything else easier.
We share a bed now. I didn't know how much I'd missed that.
[night] Goodnight, {OTHER_nameDef}. It's nice to say it without calling across the room.

warm.li: Thank you, from both of us.

blunt.li: Good. Don't knock before noon.

cheerful.li: A bed for two! We may never get up again.

gloomy.li: For once, the night doesn't feel so cold.

plain.li: Separate beds again tonight.
I suppose {OTHER_nameDef} and I will keep meeting in the hallway, then.

warm.li: It's alright. {OTHER_nameDef} and I will manage.

gloomy.li: Goodnight across the room. Again.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {THING} for {FOR_possessive} room
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A small piece of furniture to make a bedroom feel lived-in.

plain.li: I keep my things in a heap on the floor. With {THING}, my room would feel like a home.
Could someone build me {THING}? Just something to put my things on.
My clothes live in a pile on the floor. I'd like them to live somewhere better.
[trait:Greedy] A proper bedroom has proper furniture. Mine has a bed.

warm.li: It's a tiny thing, but {THING} by my bed would make me so happy.

blunt.li: Nothing in my room but the bed. Get me {THING}.

cheerful.li: I've already picked the spot for {THING}. Now I just need someone to build it!

gloomy.li: A bed and bare walls. Maybe {THING} would make it feel less like a cell.

cold.li: Having {THING} would improve my rest. It's a small cost.

plain.li: It's perfect. My room finally looks lived in.
Everything has a place now, and none of it's on the floor.

cheerful.li: Real furniture! I'm basically nobility now.

blunt.li: Good. Exactly what I wanted.

plain.li: The floor works as a shelf, I suppose.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: light in {FOR_possessive} bedroom
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Night owls and colonists who've been left in the dark want a light in their room.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: {FOR_nameDef}'s bedroom has no light any more.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {FOR_possessive} bedroom has a light source, for example {THING}.

plain.li: It's pitch black in my room. I stubbed my toe four times last night. Could I get {THING}?
Some light in my room would be nice, for reading or mending before bed.
[trigger:dark] I tripped over my own boots in the dark last night and cracked my knee on the bedframe.
[night] It's black as a mine in there. One light, that's all.
[trait:NightOwl] I'm awake when everyone else sleeps. Let me at least see what I'm doing.
[winter] Winter nights are long enough without spending them in the dark.

warm.li: I'll admit I don't like the dark much. It would help to have {THING} by the bed.

blunt.li: My room is a cave. Give me {THING}.

cheerful.li: Imagine reading in bed by the light of {THING}!

gloomy.li: The dark gets into your head after a while. I'd sleep easier with {THING}.

cold.li: Darkness hurts efficiency. Installing {THING} solves that.

plain.li: I can see my own feet again. Thank you.
[night] Light at night. I can finally find my boots.

gloomy.li: The shadows don't reach the bed anymore. Thank you.

cheerful.li: It's so cozy now! I've been reading in bed every night.

plain.li: I'll keep feeling my way around in the dark.
[night] Another night in the dark.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {SUBJECT} at night
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: After sleeping in the cold or heat, this colonist wants their bedroom kept comfortable.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: The {THINGBARE} is gone from {FOR_nameDef}'s bedroom, and the nights there aren't comfortable any more.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {FOR_possessive} bedroom gets {THING}, or simply stays comfortable through the night.

plain.li: Another bad night in my room. Put {THING} in there and I'd sleep fine.
I can't sleep with my room the way it is at night. Having {THING} in there would fix it.
[trigger:cold] My teeth chattered so hard last night I bit my tongue. Some heat in the bedroom, please.
[trigger:cold] I woke up with frost on my blanket this morning.
[trigger:heat] I woke up soaked in sweat again. We need to cool that room down.
[trigger:heat] It's like sleeping inside a cooking pot in there.
[lowtech,trigger:cold] Even a small fire in the bedroom would do. The nights are bitter.
[old,trigger:cold] Old bones and cold nights don't mix.

warm.li: I hate to ask, but the nights in my room are rough. Could we get {THING} in there?

blunt.li: Nights in my room are unbearable. I want {THING} in there. Today.

cheerful.li: Good news, I survived the night! Better news would be {THING} in my room.

gloomy.li: Another night of lying awake, shivering or sweating. Does anyone even notice?

cold.li: Poor sleep temperature lowers my performance. Install {THING}.

plain.li: {FOR_nameDef} woke up miserable again. Could we put {THING} in {FOR_possessive} room?
I slept through the whole night for once.
[winter] I was warm all night. I'd forgotten what that was like.
[summer] Cool air at night. I slept like a stone.

blunt.li: Finally, a decent night's sleep.

cheerful.li: Perfect temperature! I could hug whoever did this.

plain.li: I'll pile on blankets or kick them off, whatever the night calls for.
[winter] I'll sleep in my coat, then. Again.

gloomy.li: I'm getting used to not sleeping, which can't be good.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a table to eat at
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Eating off the floor gets old. This colonist wants a proper place to eat.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: The colony has no table indoors to eat at any more.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: There's a dining table inside a room, for example {THING}.

plain.li: I ate dinner crouched next to a woodpile again. We need {THING}.
Just a table, somewhere we can sit and eat together.
[trigger:floor] I ate dinner off my knees again. Like an animal.
[trigger:floor] Somebody stepped in my soup on the way past. I was eating on the floor.
[rain] Eating in the mud when it rains is a special kind of misery.
[old] I'm too old to eat squatting. Get us a table.
[trait:Gourmand] Good food deserves a table. Even bad food deserves a table.

warm.li: It would be lovely to share meals around a real table, like a family.

blunt.li: I'm not an animal. Build a table.

cheerful.li: Imagine us all around one table, passing the food and telling bad jokes. Let's build {THING}!

gloomy.li: Eating alone on the floor. What are we even doing out here.

cold.li: Eating without a table is degrading and inefficient.

plain.li: A real table. We eat like people now.
Chairs too. I'd forgotten how nice it is to sit down to eat.
[evening] Supper at a table. I didn't know how much I'd missed it.

warm.li: I love that we can all sit together now.

cheerful.li: Pass the salt! I've always wanted to say that.

plain.li: Back to eating off my knees.
No table, then. I'll eat standing up.

blunt.li: Fine. The floor it is.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: something new to do for fun
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Bored colonists want a new kind of recreation.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: The new way to pass the time that {FOR_nameDef} asked for is gone.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: A new kind of recreation becomes available in the colony, for example {THING}.

plain.li: I've run out of ways to pass the evening. What about {THING}?
We need something to do in the evenings that isn't staring at the wall. Maybe {THING}?
[trigger:cabin] If I spend one more day staring at these walls, I'll start talking to them.
[winter] Long winter and nothing new to do. We'll all go mad before spring.
[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] Even I need a break now and then, and the ones we have are getting old.
[lowmood] It's the same games every night, with the same faces. I'm sick of all of it.
[child] I'm bored. I'm SO bored. Everything here is boring.

warm.li: Something fun for everyone would do us all good. How about {THING}?

blunt.li: I'm bored out of my skull. Build {THING} or I start making my own fun.

cheerful.li: Game night! All we need is {THING}, and maybe some snacks.

gloomy.li: Every evening is the same as the last one. I'd settle for anything new.

cold.li: Recreation variety prevents breakdowns. Building {THING} is a sound investment.

plain.li: Something new to do. I've already lost twice.
[winter] Something to do while the snow piles up. Thank you.

cheerful.li: This is the best thing that has happened since we got here!

blunt.li: About time. I'm good at this, by the way.

plain.li: Back to watching the clouds go by.
[winter] I'll sit and watch the snow come down, I suppose.

gloomy.li: Same old evenings. I'll go back to staring at the wall.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a plant for {FOR_possessive} room
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Someone who loves growing things wants a little greenery in their room.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: The plant pot is gone from {FOR_nameDef}'s room.

plain.li: Could I have {THING} in my room? I like having something alive nearby.
A few flowers by the bed. It's silly, but it would help.
[winter] Everything outside is dead. I want one green thing in my room.
My hands miss soil when I'm indoors.

warm.li: I'd look after it so well. Just one little plant in my room, please?

cheerful.li: I already know what I'll plant: daylilies, or roses, or both!

gloomy.li: Most things out here are trying to kill us. I'd like one plant by my bed that isn't.

blunt.li: I want a plant pot in my room. It's not complicated.

plain.li: I water it every morning before work.
[winter] A bit of green in the middle of winter. That'll do.

gloomy.li: There's something alive in my room besides me. I like that.

plain.li: I'll just visit the fields when I miss the green.
